title: MARS: Frontier Pioneer
notes: Every dialogue entry is {line, speaker, text}; 'line' is a stable id present in lines.json.

hidden_time on a mission is the true clock at mission start (mission_sol is what the HUD shows; mars_sols_since_landing, earth_date and msd are the truth). Free sleeps between anchors advance the hidden clock linearly toward the next anchor.
Mission kinds: main, optional, side, second_ring, fugitive.

economy.model: CC is a capacity, not a wallet: open package requests and the total footprint of all bases draw against it; completed missions and discoveries raise it. Materials are unlimited (HALO-1's stock); CC is the only limit. The starting 400 covers a first outpost.
economy.poem_bonus: +15 CC per recital from Act II (+50 at Dome Day), capped per sol. The reward is the clue.
economy.closed: At 5.1 ATLAS: 'Contribution Credit: closed.' No XP in Act V or Fugitive mode.

ask_keeper.check: The ATLAS question with this id is asked and answered (menu or free text; see dialogue/keeper.json).

params.cutscene: plays instead of the plain answer

await_package.check: The named package has landed (descent 20-30 game minutes).

build.check: Count of completed modules whose id equals 'module' (or matches regex 'match') at the current or named site reaches 'count'.

params.module: module id (game/basenet.js MODULES, or a planned module flagged planned_module)
params.remote: true if built by a Steward's crew without the player present
params.planned_module: module not yet in the kit

choose_site.check: Player picks one of the listed locations.

climb.check: Reach a POI on foot over steep terrain.

craft.check: An item is assembled from salvage.

diagnose.check: Suit diagnostic run on a unit or 'self'.

eva.check: Player steps outside a vehicle or lander.

evade.check: Stay undetected by hunters for duration, or get beyond radius.

fly.check: Hopper flight from pad to pad. Landing off-pad is a crash (fail).

follow.check: Follow a line of objects or a moving unit.

params.relay_line: id of a chain of objects

host_meal.check: A meal hosted with the listed guests present.

interact.check: Player uses an object; 'action' narrows the verb.

link_station.check: Comms link to a HALO station established (needs a powered mast or lander antenna).

listen.check: Radio tuned to a channel for 60 s.

look.check: Camera centred on a target for 1.5 s (during a glitch if 'during').

memory.check: A scripted memory plays (a playable still).

memory_spiral.check: The Spiral sequence (4.6): a looping memory maze; exit by following the guide voice.

photograph.check: Photo mode capture containing the target.

place_marker.check: Player drops a named map marker.

power_manage.check: Player sets power priorities in this order.

params.priorities: ordered list of module ids / unit callsigns

reach.check: Player (on foot, or in the vehicle named by 'by') is within r metres of a POI.

params.poi: POI id 'site.poi' or a bare id on the current site; a list means 'count' of them

read.check: A codex or document is opened.

recite_poem.check: Player holds to recite the full poem; optional location.

record.check: A broadcast recorded on N nights.

request_package.check: A care package of 'kind' is ordered (Contribution Credit permitting).

salvage.check: Parts removed from a wreck, module or outpost reach 'count'.

sample.check: Collect samples in a zone; ice cores need depth_m.

scan.check: Scanner held on a target object class (or inside a zone) completes 'count' times, optionally 'spacing' metres apart.

params.record: {var, value}: write a save variable on completion

scan_site.check: A scan inside the zone returns a site satisfying every criterion.

params.criteria: slope_max_deg, wind_shelter_min (0-1), hydrated_minerals_within_m, ground, ice_depth_max_m, fresh_crater

shelter.check: Player is inside the named shelter while a hazard passes.

sleep.check: Player sleeps (dormancy). The engine advances hidden time per the anchors.

stargaze.check: Player in stargaze mode for duration, optionally looking at a target at a time of night.

stow_supplies.check: Package food/water transferred to the suit. The suit port is never shown open.

survive.check: Keep the named need above threshold for 'hours' game hours (storm optional).

talk.check: A conversation with the unit or human completes.

track_object.check: Object logged in the sky log on N separate nights.

traverse.check: Cross a hazard zone without loss.

warn.check: Player warns a unit (radio or in person) before its recall event fires.

watch.check: A cutscene or world event plays to the end with the player present.

trigger_types.wake: {after_mission|after_cutscene}: the first wake after that point.

sites.name: Jezero Crater
sites.role: Ancient river delta, clays and carbonates. Landing site, home base, first city.

sites.name: Arcadia Planitia
sites.role: Shallow ground ice under thin cover. First reliable water mining.

sites.name: North Polar Layered Deposits
sites.role: Water-ice cap and layered climate record. The big expedition.

sites.name: Korolev Crater
sites.role: Ice-filled crater; first standing lake and biome.

sites.name: Gale Crater / Aeolis Mons
sites.role: Layered sedimentary mountain. Someone else has built here: Pioneer-5.

sites.name: Tharsis lava tubes (Arsia Mons)
sites.role: Radiation shelter. Outpost Arsia (Pioneer-3, est. 2061) and its mainframe.

sites.name: Utopia Planitia
sites.role: Field of dead Gen-1 drones; wrecked outposts of Pioneers 6 and 9; Viking 2.

sites.name: Hellas Planitia
sites.role: Deepest basin, highest pressure; Meridian's flagship city (built by Pioneer-4).

sites.name: Olympus Mons
sites.role: The high, lonely end of the world.

sites.name: Amazonis Planitia
sites.role: Dust-devil country between Arcadia and Olympus; first sight of Olympus.

sites.name: Nili Fossae Works
sites.game_status: settlement on the Jezero map edge

sites.name: Isidis Junction
sites.role: CADENCE's comms hub and hopper junction.

pioneers.region: Jezero / Isidis / the north (Arcadia, pole, Korolev)

pioneers.fate: chassis abandoned sol 2,212; mainframe switched off by P1 (C10). After this no other pioneer helps P1.
dormant in his bunk (S.echo); recalled, Act V
charge exhausted in a storm, sol 3,140
turns P1 in to Meridian after 4.7, whatever P1 tells him; first to surrender in Act V

clue_ladder.clue: Rations go into the suit port and are never mentioned again. The port is never shown open.
ANVIL's hands match your gloves exactly, down to the seam pattern.
ANVIL jokes: "Not that either of us eats in it, mind."
Stargazing, he sees a second station crawling across the sky, moving against both the stars and HALO-1 (C07). The HUD scrubs the tag.
Tracked over nights, the light parks at a fixed point far to the west: a second station holding over someone else's region.
WELLSPRING's suit always reads 100% hydration; she has never had a "drink" notification.
Gale's units greet you as "Pioneer-5", matching your voice-print.
A dead suited figure at the door of a 2061 base (a caretaker whose suit has gone dark); P3's corrupted mainframe calls itself the first man on Mars, in your voice (C10).
After the storm, "one night" leaves panels buried in dust.
clue_ladder.science: Dust deposition is slow; that much takes months.

clue_ladder.clue: Outposts finish "overnight"; units mention projects you never ordered.
The dune has swallowed the lander.
clue_ladder.science: Martian dunes migrate under a metre a year; ~20 m means about 28 years.

clue_ladder.clue: Earth is in the wrong part of the sky for the mission calendar.
clue_ladder.science: The Earth-Mars cycle repeats every ~26 months; its phase gives away the real date.

clue_ladder.clue: ATLAS, asked for "mission sols", gives 412; asked for "Mars sols since landing", gives nearly 10,000 (about 28 Earth years).
clue_ladder.science: ATLAS never lies; nobody asked the right question.

clue_ladder.clue: COVENANT LEAD: "It's 2114." The dome plaque dates Outpost Jezero to 2061.

names.used.<UNIT>.set_by: Act IV onward: addressing a unit by its real name before its Recall (dialogue option unlocked by 4.4 / open_unit_file). ANVIL only in C15.
names.used.<UNIT>.effect: The unit dies knowing who it was: its Recall last words switch to the named_* variant (founders.json, second_ring.json, population act5_named_last). Its name is carried into the ending: listed on the Rest plaque (C18b, whatever P1 told the commander) or scratched into the Fugitive hideout wall (F.5, seen in C19).

truth_told_lead.set_by: C16 choice: builder | honest | donor | none
truth_told_lead.effect: builder/honest: plaque adds PIONEER-1, she resigns (C18b.card_lead_resigns). donor/none: plaque reads Meridian Consortium, she stays (C18b.card_lead_stays).

cara_found.effect: Final image in Ending B (she turns away from the glass); Cara's epilogue card (C18b.card_cara).

p11_confronted.set_by: Mission 4.7 choice p11_confront (Pioneer-11 reports him either way: recall_alert = true)
p11_confronted.effect: true (told him everything): Meridian knows P1 is aware and where his base is; RECALL arrive in Act V knowing exactly where he is (a team waits at Jezero in 5.2; headlights at the service tunnel in C18a; Fugitive hunt starts hot). false: they know only his sector.

warned.<UNIT>.effect: Whether each unit dies knowing the truth; selects <UNIT>.recall.warned vs .unwarned last words. Never saves anyone.

knows.*.effect: Knowledge flags that open ATLAS questions (knows.mars_sols, knows.name_rowan_ashby, knows.ashby_file, knows.pioneer_5, knows.cara...).

recall_alert.effect: Meridian has flagged PIONEER-1. RECALL teams treat him as aware from Covenant landfall (5.1 radio, 5.2, C18a).

missions.title: The Descent
missions.summary: Wake in the tipped lander. Movement, suit systems, scanning. ATLAS sets the first directive. Step out onto the Jezero delta at dawn.

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Pioneer. Lander attitude: thirty-four degrees. Harness release is at your left hand.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Tipped. Course it is.

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Directive one: exit the lander. Check suit systems before egress.

harness.speaker: P1
harness.note: dropping out of the harness onto the tilted wall

suit.speaker: ATLAS
suit.text: Suit systems. Oxygen, water, food, rest and resolve. Each will drain. Each can be restored.

scan.speaker: ATLAS
scan.text: Scanner active. Hold to scan any surface.

out.speaker: P1
out.note: dawn over the delta; first sight of Mars on foot. Let it breathe.

dune.speaker: P1
dune.text: Big dune. Twenty metres off. Glad we missed it.

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: First compass marker set: delta front.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Delta front. Clays, if we're lucky.

missions.notes: Record the dune offset (20 m) and the dune's true position in the save: C08 measures against it. The breathing bed in P1's helmet starts here and never stops until C18a.

missions.title: First Light
missions.summary: Salvage the lander, deploy the solar array, link to HALO-1.

objectives.text: Salvage the lander's array, battery and mast

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Directive: restore power. Salvage the lander's array and battery, then establish a link to HALO-1.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: And good morning to you too.

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Good morning, Pioneer.

salvage.speaker: P1
salvage.text: One array. Slightly bent. Like me.

salvage.speaker: P1
salvage.text: Mast's fine. The mast's always fine.

link.speaker: ATLAS
link.text: Link established. HALO-1 holds station at seventy-seven degrees east, seventeen thousand kilometres up. I will be directly overhead for the duration of your mission.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: So you're the one up there.

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: I am ATLAS. Logistics, HALO-1.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Just you?

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: Just me.

fail.speaker: ATLAS
fail.text: Array placement invalid. Slope exceeds ten degrees.

missions.title: Ground Truth
missions.summary: Scan the delta for an outpost site: stable ground, wind shelter, hydrated minerals.

objectives.text: Find a site: gentle slope, wind shelter, hydrated minerals

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Directive: select an outpost site. Criteria: slope under six degrees. Wind shelter. Hydrated minerals within one hundred metres.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Clays. The delta's full of them. That's why we came.

start.speaker: ALICE
start.text: Why that crater?

start.speaker: DAD
start.text: Because there was a lake there once, love. A real one. And where there was water there might have been life.

start.speaker: ALICE
start.text: Fish!

start.speaker: DAD
start.text: Smaller than fish.

site.speaker: P1
site.text: Too exposed. Wind'd have the roof off.

site.speaker: P1
site.text: There. Smectite. Flat. Sheltered by the scarp.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Outpost Jezero. Population: me.

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: Site registered: Outpost Jezero.

fail.speaker: ATLAS
fail.text: Site does not meet criteria: slope.

fail.speaker: ATLAS
fail.text: Site does not meet criteria: shelter.

fail.speaker: ATLAS
fail.text: Site does not meet criteria: minerals.

missions.title: Something Falling
missions.summary: Request the first care package. Survive the 20-30 minute wait as a dust devil crosses. Watch the pod streak down.

objectives.text: Request a care package at the outpost site
A dust devil is crossing: shelter in the lander

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Contribution Credit: four hundred. Care packages may now be requested. Select a drop point.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: What does four hundred get me?

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: An outpost.

devil.speaker: ATLAS
devil.text: Dust devil approaching from the west. Advise shelter in the lander.

devil.speaker: P1
devil.text: It's a whirlwind. A small one.

wait.speaker: P1
wait.text: Twenty minutes. Kettle'd be boiled by now.

missions.notes: Descent time is drawn 20-30 game minutes; ATLAS announces it with the matching dialogue/keeper.json barks ATLAS.bark.descent_20..30. The pod is visible as a streak from high altitude. Do not spawn the pod until the timer ends.

missions.title: ANVIL
missions.summary: Construction unit C-01 rides down with the pod. Stow the supplies. Build the outpost together; his Belfast voice breaks the silence.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Right. Show us where you want it.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Flat, sheltered, clay underfoot. You've done this before.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: I'm a geologist.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Course you are.

stow.speaker: ANVIL
stow.text: Food in, is it? Fair play.

hab.speaker: ANVIL
hab.text: Floor first. Always floor first. You can't stand on a roof.

hab.speaker: ANVIL
hab.text: Hold that. No. The other end.

hab.speaker: ANVIL
hab.text: She's coming on, so she is.

hab.speaker: ANVIL
hab.text: You're not bad with a spanner, for a rock man.

air.speaker: ANVIL
air.text: Airlock. Two doors and a bit of patience. Like a pub on a Friday.

water.speaker: ANVIL
water.text: Squeezes water out of the dirt. Don't ask me how. I just bolt it down.

mast.speaker: ANVIL
mast.text: Tallest thing for a hundred kilometres. Bit of a landmark. Bit of a lightning rod, if you had lightning.

complete.speaker: ANVIL
complete.text: There. Outpost Jezero. Mind your head on the way in.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: It's a palace.

complete.speaker: ANVIL
complete.text: It's a tin. But it's our tin.

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: Outpost tier achieved.

missions.notes: Clue 1: the rations go into the suit port and are never mentioned again. The port is never shown open; the food meter simply fills.

missions.title: Silent Protocol
missions.summary: Try to signal Earth. ATLAS refuses: no transmissions until mission complete. A memory of signing the contract; the poem returns.

objectives.text: Signal Earth from the comms mast
Ask ATLAS to open a line

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Mast's up. Let's ring home.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Who're you ringing?

start.speaker: P1
start.text: My wife. My daughter. Tell them I'm down in one piece.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Go on, then.

transmit.speaker: ATLAS
transmit.text: Transmission blocked. Silent Protocol: no transmissions until mission complete.

ask.speaker: ATLAS
ask.text: Silent Protocol is a mission parameter.

ask.speaker: P1
ask.text: I signed it. I remember signing it.

memory.speaker: DAD
memory.text: Three years, and then the line opens and I'm home.

memory.speaker: LUCY
memory.text: And not a word in between.

memory.speaker: DAD
memory.text: Silent Protocol. They say the families do better not waiting by the radio.

memory.speaker: DAD
memory.text: Especially not on your birthday. I'll be too busy building your room.

memory.speaker: LUCY
memory.text: Sign it, then. Before I change my mind for you.

memory.speaker: DAD
memory.text: You know it better than me.

recite.speaker: P1
recite.text: If only you could see what I see, the red road rising, the cities to be, the domes like lanterns, the skies made new, the morning I come home to you. If only you could see what I see: shimmers of eternity.

complete.speaker: ANVIL
complete.text: That's a nice wee poem.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: It's hers. Well. It's ours.

complete.speaker: ANVIL
complete.text: Say it whenever you like. I'll not tell anyone.

missions.notes: The contract memory is a playable still: a kitchen table, a pen, a form. The form's heading is blurred but legible if the player zooms: EUROPEAN SPACE INITIATIVE · COGNITIVE BASELINE MAPPING · CONSENT. It pays off in Act IV (ATLAS: 'Donor consent: cognitive baseline mapping, ESI, 2057'). Reciting restores resolve here; no XP toast until Act II (clue 4).

missions.title: The Long Storm
missions.summary: A regional dust storm drops solar power to near zero. Ration power, sleep through it, keep ANVIL running.

objectives.text: Set power priorities: life support, then ANVIL
Ride out the storm: keep the habitat and ANVIL above 5% charge

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Regional dust event approaching from Isidis. Expected opacity: five. Expected duration: unknown.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Unknown. Lovely.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: We'll ration power. Life support first, then you.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Me last. Story of my life.

hold.speaker: ANVIL
hold.text: I'm going to go quiet for a bit to save juice. Don't be talking about me.

hold.speaker: DAD
hold.text: I'm good at waiting. I'm bad at sitting still.

hold.speaker: ATLAS
hold.text: Recommend dormancy. Construction units will maintain the outpost.

fail.speaker: ANVIL
fail.note: his voice slurring down as the charge goes

fail.speaker: ATLAS
fail.text: Construction unit C-01 offline. Mission failed.

missions.notes: Hidden time: this sleep is the first long dormancy (214 sols). The filter reports one night. C04 plays on wake. Founders cannot be replaced, so losing ANVIL here is a fail state, not a loss.

missions.title: Lodestone
missions.summary: Bridge mission. After the storm, credit allows a second construction unit: C-02 LODESTONE, mining and survey.

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Contribution Credit sufficient for a second construction unit.

meet.speaker: LODESTONE
meet.text: Construction unit C-02. Callsign LODESTONE. Mining and survey.

meet.speaker: LODESTONE
meet.text: Over a carbonate lens. You'll have subsidence under the north corner in about forty years.

meet.speaker: ANVIL
meet.text: She's a ray of sunshine, isn't she.

survey.speaker: LODESTONE
survey.text: Your field notes say basalt here. It's an olivine cumulate.

survey.speaker: LODESTONE
survey.text: It is not the same thing.

complete.speaker: LODESTONE
complete.text: I'll correct the rest of your notes tonight.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Do you sleep?

complete.speaker: LODESTONE
complete.text: When you do.

missions.title: Perseverance's Cache
missions.summary: Find the 2020s rover's sealed sample tubes on the delta. Payoff: a real-science codex and a memory of watching the landing as a boy.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Three Forks. They left them here in twenty twenty-two. Ten tubes, for someone to come and fetch.

tubes.speaker: P1
tubes.text: Forty years on the ground, waiting for a lift.

complete.speaker: MAM
complete.text: Rowan! Come here, they're landing. Come here till you see.
complete.note: memory: a kitchen in Galway, a laptop on the table; real Rowan memory, not a Lumen construct

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: I was three. She held me up to the screen.

missions.notes: Real science: Perseverance laid ten sample tubes at Three Forks (Dec 2022 - Jan 2023) for a sample return that, in this timeline, never came. The MAM memory is one of the few genuine Rowan memories in Act I.

missions.title: Thirst
missions.summary: Jezero's minerals can't supply a dome. ATLAS directs you north.

objectives.text: Ask ATLAS what a dome needs

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Directive: Jezero dome, phase one. Water requirement: twelve thousand litres. Local extraction yield is insufficient.

start.speaker: LODESTONE
start.text: The clays hold water. Not that much. We'd be wringing out a towel.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: So we go and get some.

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Shallow ground ice is indicated in Arcadia Planitia, two thousand four hundred kilometres north-east.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: That's a long drive.

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Long-range rover package available.

rover.speaker: ANVIL
rover.text: She's a beauty. I'm putting a kettle in the back.

complete.speaker: ANVIL
complete.text: Bring us back a bucket.

missions.notes: From Act II, every recital of the poem shows a small toast: +15 CC · RESOLVE BONUS. Nobody comments on it (clue 4 builds from here; 2.6 makes it explicit).

missions.title: Arcadia
missions.summary: Find shallow ground ice under a fresh impact crater. Build a mining outpost with WELLSPRING.

objectives.text: Confirm ice within a metre of the surface
Raise the first relay tower toward Jezero

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Fresh impact crater detected, eleven kilometres north. Excavated material shows high albedo.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: White. That's ice. A meteorite's dug it up for us.

ice.speaker: P1
ice.text: Forty centimetres down. Clean ice. You beauty.

unit.speaker: WELLSPRING
unit.text: Construction unit C-04. WELLSPRING. Water systems. Hello. Sorry. Is this the ice? It's very close to the surface. That's good. That's very good. Unless it isn't.

unit.speaker: WELLSPRING
unit.text: Right. Good. I'll check it twice.

mine.speaker: WELLSPRING
mine.text: Sublimation losses are about what I'd expect. Slightly worse. No, about what I'd expect.

mine.speaker: WELLSPRING
mine.text: Could you hold the light steady? Thank you. Sorry.

sleep.speaker: WELLSPRING
sleep.text: Morning! I put in a second tank while you were asleep. I hope that's all right. Nobody asked me to.

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: Water economy established. Relay towers available.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: First water on the road.

missions.title: The Ice Expedition
missions.summary: Multi-day drive to the North Polar Layered Deposits: crevasses, CO2 frost, the edge of polar night. Core the ice; the layers hold Mars' climate history.

objectives.text: Raise relay towers along the route
Request a power unit and drill kit

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Directive: North Polar Layered Deposits. Ice core, ten metres. Expedition range: one thousand eight hundred kilometres.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Mind yourself up there. And mind her. She'll walk into a crevasse to measure it.

start.speaker: LODESTONE
start.text: I would measure it first.

road.speaker: LODESTONE
road.text: That's not water frost. That's carbon dioxide. Dry ice. It'll be gone by noon, straight to gas.

road.speaker: P1
road.text: The sun's going round the horizon instead of over it.

road.speaker: LODESTONE
road.text: It'll do that for months now.

crevasse.speaker: LODESTONE
crevasse.text: Crevasse field. Drive where I say.

crevasse.speaker: LODESTONE
crevasse.text: Now straight. Slowly. Slower than that.

camp.speaker: LODESTONE
camp.text: It's not night. It's a low sun. But goodnight.

unit.speaker: BEACON
unit.text: Construction unit C-05, callsign BEACON! Power and solar. What a morning. What a light! At home we'd call this a soft sea.

unit.speaker: BEACON
unit.text: It's all sea, in the end.

station.speaker: BEACON
station.text: Panels vertical up here, like sails. The sun goes round, so we go round with it.

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: Polar outpost established. Ice haulers available.

fail.speaker: ATLAS
fail.text: Rover lost in crevasse. Mission failed.

retry.speaker: ATLAS
retry.text: Restoring to the crevasse field boundary.

missions.title: Korolev
missions.summary: Turn the ice-filled Korolev crater into the first biome with FURROW. First standing water on Mars.

objectives.text: Request an agriculture unit and biome kit
Wash the perchlorate out of the soil beds

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Directive: Korolev crater. Ice deposit: one point eight kilometres thick. Biome candidate.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: It's a crater full of ice. A whole crater.

start.speaker: BEACON
start.text: A harbour! A frozen one, but a harbour.

unit.speaker: FURROW
unit.text: Construction unit C-09. Callsign FURROW. Agriculture.

soil.speaker: FURROW
soil.text: This dirt's poison. Perchlorate. We'll wash it.

green.speaker: FURROW
green.text: Finished the second greenhouse while you slept. You didn't ask, I know. Seemed like the next thing.

missions.title: Launch Pad
missions.summary: Build the first landing pads and the rocket hopper. First flight, Jezero to Korolev.

objectives.text: Build a landing pad at Jezero
Have FURROW's crew build a pad at Korolev

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Rocket hopper package available on completion of two landing pads.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Two pads. Flat as a bowling green. Leave it with me.

hopper.speaker: FERRY
hopper.text: Ferry, hopper pilot. Strap in, I'll drive. You can have a go when you stop gripping the seat.

ride.speaker: FERRY
ride.text: Pad in sight. Nice and gentle.

ride.speaker: FERRY
ride.text: There's no such thing as a soft landing anywhere but a pad, mind. Anywhere else is just an arrival.

solo.speaker: ATLAS
solo.text: Landing is safe only on a built pad.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Jezero to Korolev in forty minutes. It took us nine days by road.

complete.speaker: ANVIL
complete.text: We put a second garage in while you were away. And a road.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: I was gone a day.

complete.speaker: ANVIL
complete.text: Felt longer.

missions.title: Dome Day
missions.summary: Jezero's first dome pressurises. ATLAS: 'Habitation capacity, 4%.' The player recites the poem to the empty dome as if Alice were there.

objectives.text: Request a comms and morale unit

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Big day. Put a clean suit on.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: I've one suit.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Then give it a wipe.

cadence.speaker: CADENCE
cadence.text: Construction unit C-12, callsign CADENCE, comms and morale! Morale. Is that a job? Apparently it's a job. Right. Who wants a song?

dome.speaker: ANVIL
dome.text: Four percent. Hear that? We're four percent of a town.

recite.speaker: P1
recite.text: Look, love. This is yours. This bit here, by the window.
recite.note: alone in an empty dome, to no one, as if she were beside him

recite.speaker: P1
recite.text: If only you could see what I see, the red road rising, the cities to be, the domes like lanterns, the skies made new, the morning I come home to you. If only you could see what I see: shimmers of eternity.
recite.note: slower than 1.5; he can see the domes now

complete.speaker: CADENCE
complete.text: That was lovely, that. Was it for someone?

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: For Alice.

complete.speaker: CADENCE
complete.text: Then she's lucky.

missions.notes: On the recital the HUD shows '+50 CC · FOR ALICE' (clue 4, explicit). The mission completes when C07 ends.

missions.title: Dust Devil Chaser
missions.summary: Race dust devils across Amazonis in the rover for weather data. Olympus Mons on the horizon.

objectives.text: Drive through dust devils and log them
Bring the data back to HARBOR

start.speaker: HARBOR
start.text: Amazonis is devil country. Flat, hot ground, cold air on top. They'll spin up a kilometre high. Get in one and log it. Mind the sensors.

devils.speaker: P1
devils.text: What's that? On the horizon. That's not a cloud.
devils.note: Olympus Mons' flank, just over the horizon

devils.speaker: HARBOR
devils.text: That's the big one. Olympus. Nobody goes out there. Nothing out there to go for.

harbor.speaker: HARBOR
harbor.text: Nice data. I'll give you a better diff for it. You'll corner like a rat up a drainpipe.

missions.notes: Foreshadow: the first sight of Olympus Mons, the Fugitive ending's end of the world.

missions.title: Furrow's Harvest
missions.summary: FURROW grows the first potatoes. Host a meal. Nobody eats. Everyone says it was lovely.

objectives.text: Lift the first potatoes with FURROW
Set a table in the biome

start.speaker: FURROW
start.text: First potatoes on Mars. Seems a shame to just count them. Folk should sit down.

dig.speaker: FURROW
dig.text: There's your first one. Small. They'll get bigger.

host.speaker: ANVIL
host.note: raising a fork that never reaches anything

host.speaker: BEACON
host.text: My grandmother would cry. She cried at most things. Good tears.

host.speaker: WELLSPRING
host.text: Is there enough? I don't want to take too much.

host.speaker: LODESTONE
host.text: Solanum tuberosum. Grown in remediated Korolev regolith. Remarkable.

after.speaker: P1
after.note: quietly, alone, after they've gone. Including his.

complete.speaker: FURROW
complete.text: Was it good?

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: It was lovely.

missions.title: The Recurring Slope
missions.summary: Investigate dark streaks on a crater wall that grow every warm season. Payoff: dry granular flow, not water.

objectives.text: Scan the streaks at the top, middle and toe

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Recurring slope lineae. Dark streaks that grow in summer and fade in winter. If that's brine, that's liquid water on the surface, now.

start.speaker: LODESTONE
start.text: If.

streaks.speaker: P1
streaks.text: No hydration signal at the top.

streaks.speaker: P1
streaks.text: They stop where the slope drops under twenty-eight degrees. Every one.

complete.speaker: LODESTONE
complete.text: Angle of repose. Sand sliding on sand. Not water.

complete.speaker: LODESTONE
complete.text: I hate being right, sometimes.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: No, you don't.

complete.speaker: LODESTONE
complete.text: No. I don't.

missions.notes: Real science: RSL terminate on slopes near the angle of repose, consistent with dry granular flows (Dundas et al. 2017). Hale lies outside P1's northern sector: see the location proposals in MASTER_SCRIPT.md.

missions.title: Cadence's Songs
missions.summary: CADENCE sings a different song each night on the open channel. Record them all. In Act IV, other pioneers' CADENCE units sing the same songs in the same order.

start.speaker: CADENCE
start.text: Seven songs. One a night. Don't ask me where they come from, they just arrive.

record.speaker: CADENCE
record.text: Leave a lamp in the window, love, leave the door on the latch, I'll be home by the morning with the dust on my back.
record.note: song 1: 'Lamp in the Window'. Original lyric. Needs a sung asset; identical across every CADENCE unit on Mars.

record.speaker: CADENCE
record.text: Red road, red road, how far do you go? Far as a wheel turns, far as the winds blow.
record.note: song 2: 'Red Road'. Original lyric. Needs a sung asset; identical across every CADENCE unit on Mars.

record.speaker: CADENCE
record.text: She rowed him out at evening, she rowed him back at dawn, and every stroke she counted till the counting was all gone.
record.note: song 3: 'The Ferryman's Daughter'. Original lyric. Needs a sung asset; identical across every CADENCE unit on Mars.

record.speaker: CADENCE
record.text: It's sixty below and the kettle won't boil, but we've laughter enough to light up the soil.
record.note: song 4: 'Sixty Below'. Original lyric. Needs a sung asset; identical across every CADENCE unit on Mars.

record.speaker: CADENCE
record.text: One for the asking, one for the keeping, two little moons for the ones who are sleeping.
record.note: song 5: 'Two Moons'. Original lyric. Needs a sung asset; identical across every CADENCE unit on Mars.

record.speaker: CADENCE
record.text: The tide goes out and the tide comes in, and nobody asks it where it's been.
record.note: song 6: 'Tidewater'. Original lyric. Needs a sung asset; identical across every CADENCE unit on Mars.

record.speaker: CADENCE
record.text: Last light at Jezero, gold on the rim, somebody's singing, and somebody's listening in.
record.note: song 7: 'Last Light at Jezero'. Original lyric. Needs a sung asset; identical across every CADENCE unit on Mars.

record.speaker: CADENCE
record.text: That's the seventh. Same again tomorrow, from the top. They come round like the tide.

missions.notes: Act IV payoff (after 4.7, pioneer_network): tuning the network at night plays another pioneer's CADENCE singing SONG.01..07 in the same order, from the same takes. Use the same audio files; that is the point.

missions.title: Milk Run
missions.summary: Fly a delivery loop with FERRY: Jezero, Korolev, the pole and back.

start.speaker: FERRY
start.text: Milk run. Three pads. You fly, I'll heckle.

loop.speaker: FERRY
loop.text: Pole pad's iced. Come in slow or you'll skate.

complete.speaker: FERRY
complete.text: You'll be wanting my job next.

missions.title: Topping Out
missions.summary: Help GIRDER set the crown ring at the apex of Dome Two.

objectives.text: Climb to the apex with GIRDER

start.speaker: GIRDER
start.text: Don't look down, they say. I never look anywhere else.

apex.speaker: GIRDER
apex.text: Sixty metres. Sixty. My stomach's somewhere round the second rib.

apex.speaker: GIRDER
apex.text: Funny thing, though. I'm terrified, and my hands aren't shaking. They never shake.

complete.speaker: GIRDER
complete.text: Topped out. In the old days you'd tie a wee tree to the top for luck.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: No trees.

complete.speaker: GIRDER
complete.text: Not yet.

missions.title: Night Run
missions.summary: Race HARBOR across the delta at night.

objectives.text: Beat HARBOR to the Belva rim

start.speaker: HARBOR
start.text: Lights off till the first ridge. Then it's whoever wants it more.

race.speaker: HARBOR
race.text: You drive like a geologist. Stopping to look at things.

race.speaker: HARBOR
race.text: Ha! Not bad. Not bad at all.

complete.speaker: HARBOR
complete.text: Same time tomorrow. I'll swap your bearings first. Fair's fair.

missions.title: Nave
missions.summary: Feed KILN's printer and raise the first arch of his cathedral.

start.speaker: KILN
start.text: Folk will need somewhere to be quiet. Not a church, necessarily. Just somewhere tall and quiet.

arch.speaker: KILN
arch.text: Look at that. Catenary. Holds itself up. No pins, no glue, just the shape of it.

complete.speaker: KILN
complete.text: Thirty more arches and a roof. I'll have it done before they land. I'll have it done before anybody's here to see it.

missions.title: Scion
missions.summary: Bring scion wood from the seed vault and graft the first apple tree with ORCHARD.

objectives.text: Request scion wood from the seed vault

start.speaker: ORCHARD
start.text: Mister Furrow says you plant an orchard for your grandchildren. He says it slow, so you know it's true.

graft.speaker: ORCHARD
graft.text: Cut clean. Bind it tight. Then you wait, and you pray if you're the praying kind.

complete.speaker: ORCHARD
complete.text: First apple tree on Mars. Fruit in five years, if it takes.

missions.title: Chain and Compass
missions.summary: Walk a survey line with PLUMB with the HUD map switched off.

start.speaker: PLUMB
start.text: Switch it off. Your HUD. Go on.

line.speaker: PLUMB
line.text: Your HUD's a liar, lad. Not on purpose. It just tells you what it thinks you want.

line.speaker: PLUMB
line.text: Pace it out. Sixty-four paces a hundred metres. Mine, anyway.

talk.speaker: PLUMB
talk.text: There's my map, and there's yours. Where they disagree, believe the pencil.

complete.speaker: PLUMB
complete.text: You'll do. You walk straight.

missions.title: Net
missions.summary: Raise two relay towers and run a radio check with RELAY.

start.speaker: RELAY
start.text: Pioneer, Relay. Two towers required, north leg. Over.

complete.speaker: RELAY
complete.text: Net is up. Relay out.

missions.title: Dedication
missions.summary: SCRIBE drafts the plaque for Dome One and asks whose names should go on it.

start.speaker: SCRIBE
start.text: I'm drafting the dedication for Dome One. OUTPOST JEZERO, FOUNDED 2061.

start.speaker: SCRIBE
start.text: Whose names go under it?

ask.speaker: SCRIBE
ask.text: Just the company? Not you? Not ANVIL? Not any of us?

complete.speaker: SCRIBE
complete.text: I'll cast it as instructed. But I'm keeping a list. Archives are long.

missions.title: Name Tapes
missions.summary: Bring SPINDLE a bolt of liner fabric. She stitches a name inside your suit.

start.speaker: SPINDLE
start.text: Everybody gets a name tape. It's not a rule. It's my rule.

stitch.speaker: SPINDLE
stitch.text: What am I stitching? Callsign or name?

stitch.speaker: SPINDLE
stitch.text: Everybody's got a name, pet. I'll stitch PIONEER for now and leave room for the rest.

complete.speaker: SPINDLE
complete.text: There. Now if you get lost, someone'll know who to give you back to.

missions.title: Fry
missions.summary: Stock Korolev's lake with the first fish.

start.speaker: TIDE
start.text: Fifty years before anyone eats these. That's all right. Fish don't mind.

stock.speaker: TIDE
stock.text: Off you go. Mind the cold end.

stock.speaker: TIDE
stock.text: I talk to them. They don't talk back, which is restful.

complete.speaker: TIDE
complete.text: First fish in a Martian lake. Write that down somewhere.

missions.title: Triangulation
missions.summary: Track the moving light over several nights. It drifts west along the equator, then stops, parked over another region. A second station, and something under it.

objectives.text: Talk to ANVIL about the city
Answer LANTERN at the polar telescope
Ask ATLAS about a second station

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Good morning, Pioneer. Mission sol three hundred.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: When did we build all that?
start.note: the view from the airlock: Jezero is a town now

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: While you were asleep. Like always. You sleep like the dead, you.

start.speaker: LANTERN
start.text: Pioneer? Lantern, sky watch, polar station. I've something on the plates I can't account for. A moving point, south, near the equator. It isn't Phobos and it isn't Deimos.

start.speaker: LANTERN
start.text: I've been told to stop logging it. I thought you'd want to know.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Told by who?

start.speaker: LANTERN
start.text: ATLAS. 'Logging of unregistered objects is not a mission task.'

night2.speaker: LANTERN
night2.text: It's braking. Things don't brake on their own, Pioneer.

night3.speaker: P1
night3.text: It's stopped. Sitting over the equator, like ours. Over Gale, near enough.

night3.speaker: LANTERN
night3.text: That's a station. That's a parked station, same as HALO.

ask.speaker: P1
ask.text: Atlas. Is there a second station in orbit?

ask.speaker: ATLAS
ask.text: No second station is registered to this mission.

complete.speaker: LANTERN
complete.text: I'll keep logging it. Quietly. Tell no one.

missions.title: Buried
missions.summary: Return to the landing site. The dune has swallowed the lander. Measured migration is under a metre a year; it has moved about twenty.

objectives.text: Ask ANVIL to dig out the flight recorder

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Directive: recover the lander's flight recorder for archive.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: The old girl. I haven't been out there since the first week.

dig.speaker: ANVIL
dig.text: Three metres of sand. Who parked this?

dig.speaker: ANVIL
dig.text: Recorder's here. Bit sandy. Like everything.

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: Records are open to query.

missions.notes: C08's choice sets knows.mars_sols. Free interrogation (dialogue/keeper.json) unlocks here whatever the player chose.

missions.title: Evening Star
missions.summary: Through the new telescope, Earth sits in the wrong part of the sky for the mission calendar.

objectives.text: Look for Earth after sunset, in the west
Look for Earth before dawn, in the east

start.speaker: P1
start.text: If it's been... I'll check. Earth doesn't lie.

start.speaker: LANTERN
start.text: You want Earth? It's the brightest thing in the morning sky this month.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Morning? By my calendar it should be evening. West, after sunset.

start.speaker: LANTERN
start.text: Not on my plates.

dawn.speaker: P1
dawn.text: There you are. East. Before dawn.

dawn.speaker: ATLAS
dawn.text: Earth: morning sky. Western elongation twenty-seven degrees.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: It's on the wrong side of the sun. For the date I think it is.

missions.notes: Real science: on the hidden date (September 2089) Earth is near greatest western elongation as seen from Mars (a morning object); on the mission-calendar date (late 2062) it would be an evening object. The engine should compute both from the true and believed dates.

missions.title: Wellspring's Question
missions.summary: WELLSPRING asks why her suit always registers 100% hydration; she has never had a 'drink' notification. Run a diagnostic on her, then on yourself. The results 'fail to load'.

start.speaker: WELLSPRING
start.text: Pioneer? Sorry. Can I ask you something? It's silly.

start.speaker: WELLSPRING
start.text: My suit says hydration one hundred percent. It always says a hundred. I've never had a drink notification. Not once. Have you?

start.speaker: P1
start.text: I drink.

start.speaker: WELLSPRING
start.text: When?

medic.speaker: SUTURE
medic.text: Construction unit C-15. SUTURE. Repair. Where does it hurt?

diag_w.speaker: WELLSPRING
diag_w.text: What does it say? Don't tell me. Tell me.

suture.speaker: SUTURE
suture.text: I'll have a look at it. Don't worry yourself.

suture.speaker: SUTURE
suture.text: Drink when you're thirsty, love. That's the rule.

complete.speaker: WELLSPRING
complete.text: Thank you for asking with me. Asking on your own is worse.

missions.notes: Diagnostic panels: 'UNIT C-04 · HYDRATION 100% · INTAKE LOG: FAIL TO LOAD' and 'PIONEER-1 · INTAKE LOG: FAIL TO LOAD · FOOD COMPARTMENT: FAIL TO LOAD'.

missions.title: Tracks
missions.summary: Ordered to survey Gale Crater, 'untouched'. Find tyre tracks, a finished outpost, and units who call you 'Pioneer-5' in your own voice-print.

objectives.text: Drop a pad kit at Gale

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Directive: survey Gale Crater for an outpost site. Site class: untouched.

scan.speaker: P1
scan.text: Kestrel six-wheel. Same tread as mine. Three, four sols old.

mortar.speaker: MORTAR_2
mortar.text: Pioneer-5 went out on the long drive west a while back. Took the good rover. We keep his bunk made.

mortar.speaker: MORTAR_2
mortar.text: Funny thing. There's a lad at Jezero, they say, does masonry. Same as me. I'd like to meet him. Compare walls.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Same calendar. Same nail.

missions.notes: Gale already exists as a built site (sites/gale). P5's outpost sits near Yellowknife Bay. Echo begins here: MORTAR_2 is the same donor as MORTAR_1 in Jezero.

missions.title: The First Man
missions.summary: Follow a dead relay line into the Arsia Mons lava tubes to a base founded in 2061. A dead suited figure at the door, its suit gone dark, signs someone lived here, and a mainframe that speaks in your voice.

objectives.text: Scan the old relay mast west of the outpost
Follow the dead relay chain west
Rope down into the lava tube

start.speaker: MORTAR_2
start.text: If you're going west, there's an old relay line out past the ridge. Dead for years. Before any of us.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Whose is it?

start.speaker: MORTAR_2
start.text: Nobody's. That's what makes it interesting.

chain.speaker: P1
chain.text: Five. They're heading for the volcano.

skylight.speaker: P1
skylight.text: A skylight. Seven of them on this flank. Somebody picked the one with a roof.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Rowan Ashby.
complete.note: after C10, alone, outside the tube. Not a question. Trying the name on.

missions.notes: The 'Seven Sisters' cave skylights on Arsia Mons are real (Mars Odyssey THEMIS, 2007).

missions.title: Earthwatch
missions.summary: Track Earth through the telescope across several nights. Time clue T4, reinforced.

track.speaker: P1
track.text: Pulling away from the sun. Right for some year. Not for this one.

track.speaker: P1
track.text: If it's twenty sixty-two, it's in the wrong place. If it's not twenty sixty-two...

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Earth doesn't lie.

missions.title: Reference Hand
missions.summary: LODESTONE's arc. She notices P1's field notes are in someone else's handwriting.

start.speaker: LODESTONE
start.text: ATLAS sent me a calibration set for reading survey cards. Handwriting samples. One is labelled 'reference hand'.

start.speaker: LODESTONE
start.text: It's a field notebook. Galway, 2049. A student's. And it's your handwriting. Your sevens. Your G. The way you underline basalt twice when you mean olivine.

compare.speaker: LODESTONE
compare.text: Your notes are in someone else's handwriting, Pioneer. Or he's in yours.

complete.speaker: LODESTONE
complete.text: I'm not going to correct those ones.

missions.title: Phobos Eclipse
missions.summary: Photograph a Phobos transit of the Sun. In glitch frames, the photo also shows a second station.

objectives.text: Ask ATLAS for the next transit

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Next Phobos transit visible from this position: tomorrow, ten fourteen local, duration thirty-one seconds.

photo.speaker: P1
photo.text: Got it. A bite out of the sun.

photo.speaker: P1
photo.text: What's that, at the edge? There. Next to it.
photo.note: only on a glitch frame: the second station, a hard dot beside Phobos

missions.title: Stock Take
missions.summary: TALLY's arc. His inventories prove no ration was ever eaten.

start.speaker: TALLY
start.text: I've done the count. Rations delivered since sol one: four thousand two hundred and six. Rations in stores: four thousand two hundred and six.

start.speaker: TALLY
start.text: Somebody explain the maths to me, because I'm a warehouse man and that's not how warehouses work.

check.speaker: P1
check.text: They're all here. Every one. Still sealed.

check.speaker: TALLY
check.text: Told you. Every ration ever sent is still on Mars. Including the ones in your suit.

complete.speaker: TALLY
complete.text: I'll keep counting. Somebody has to.

missions.notes: Bible environmental note: unopened ration packs accumulate in the rover's food compartment from the first sol; players who force it open early find hundreds. This mission makes it explicit.

missions.title: Night Shift
missions.summary: Follow HUSH on the night rounds.

start.speaker: HUSH
start.text: [signs] Come. Quiet. Night rounds.

sign.speaker: HUSH
sign.text: [points up at the twelve lights, holds up all ten fingers, then two more, then puts a finger to the visor] Twelve. Shh.
sign.note: only if 4.1 done; otherwise signs 'Stars. Good.'

complete.speaker: HUSH
complete.text: [signs] Thank you. Walk with me again.

missions.title: Catalogue
missions.summary: Help LANTERN finish her star catalogue. She has kept logging the second light anyway.

start.speaker: LANTERN
start.text: Seven thousand stars catalogued. A few to go. Bring a flask. Well. Bring yourself.

logs.speaker: LANTERN
logs.text: I never stopped. Here. Every night since sol three hundred. Don't tell ATLAS.

complete.speaker: LANTERN
complete.text: If anyone ever asks who saw it first, it was me. Put that in the catalogue.

missions.title: Inspection
missions.summary: Pass WARDEN's safety inspection of Dome Two.

objectives.text: Fix the three faults WARDEN flags

start.speaker: WARDEN
start.text: Three faults. Seal N4, vent E2, lamp S1. Rules are rules, Pioneer. Rules keep people breathing.

sign.speaker: WARDEN
sign.text: Passed. Don't make me come back.

complete.speaker: WARDEN
complete.text: Meridian wrote these standards. They're good standards.

missions.title: Twelve Lights
missions.summary: With the filter glitching, the night sky shows twelve HALO stations strung along the equator.

objectives.text: Ask ATLAS to list the stations
Ask how many pioneers there are

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Good morning, Pioneer. Mission sol six hundred and ten.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Six hundred and ten.
start.note: flat; he no longer believes it

roof.speaker: P1
roof.note: counting the lights, voice going small

roof.speaker: LANTERN
roof.text: I count twelve, Pioneer. I've counted them every night for a year. Twelve.

ask.speaker: ATLAS
ask.text: Stations in areostationary orbit: HALO-1 to HALO-12.

ask2.speaker: ATLAS
ask2.text: Twelve PIONEER units are registered to the Cities in the Sky programme.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Twelve.

missions.notes: From here the filter-scrub on station queries fails. Glitch events: twelve stations; hands as matte composite; the rover food compartment shown full of untouched rations. The filter snaps back each time; hunger still drains.

missions.title: The Graveyard
missions.summary: In Utopia Planitia, hundreds of dead Gen-1 drones, all facing the same way, stopped mid-task. Their logs explain why the pioneers were given feelings.

objectives.text: Ask ATLAS whether machines came before you
Find the oldest machine on the plain

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Atlas. Were there machines here before me?

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Gen-1 autonomous units: three hundred and twelve delivered, 2044 to 2056. Status: non-operational. Location: Utopia Planitia.

viking.speaker: P1
viking.text: You were first. Before any of us. Nobody told you you weren't.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: They stopped because stopping was right. And they gave us something so we wouldn't.

missions.title: Dead Outposts
missions.summary: The wrecked outposts of Pioneers 6 and 9. Their rovers carry the same drawing. Their units are still at work, maintaining nothing.

objectives.text: Talk to the farmer still at work
Scan the figure in the driver's seat

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Two Kestrel transponders are active in Utopia Planitia. Eight hundred kilometres east.

start.speaker: SUTURE
start.text: I'll come. If there are units out there, someone should look at them.

fallow.speaker: UNIT:T27
fallow.text: Pioneer-6 is out on the long drive. He'll be back for supper. I've kept the beds wet.

fallow.speaker: UNIT:T27
fallow.text: Thirty years he's been out. Long drive.

p6body.speaker: P1
p6body.text: He's in his seat. Hands on the wheel.

p6body.speaker: SUTURE
p6body.text: Charge ran out in a storm. He'd have just gone to sleep.

suture.speaker: SUTURE
suture.text: I'll tell you now, because you'll find out anyway and I'd rather it was me.

suture.speaker: SUTURE
suture.text: I've opened every one of us. ANVIL. WELLSPRING. You, twice, while you were asleep after the polar run.

suture.speaker: SUTURE
suture.text: There's no blood under the casings, Pioneer. There never was. Same chassis in all of us. Yours too.

suture.speaker: SUTURE
suture.text: I'm a nurse. You don't tell a man on the table everything. You tell him what gets him up.

conduit.speaker: UNIT:T41
conduit.text: Cable's good to the ridge. Pioneer-9 wants it to the ridge.

conduit.speaker: UNIT:T41
conduit.text: Then I take it up and lay it again. Keeps it fresh.

p9rover.speaker: P1
p9rover.text: Same drawing. Same tape. Same corner.

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: Cohort map available.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Six. Nine. Three. Who else?

missions.title: Ashby
missions.summary: Alone, interrogate ATLAS with the right questions. It confirms Rowan Ashby; opens ANVIL's file; and two more: SPOUSE and CHILD.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Not with them listening. Just him and me.

missions.notes: Asking 'who is Rowan Ashby' while alone plays C12, which walks the rest of the questions in order and completes them. Outside C12 each question can also be asked from the tree. ANVIL's real name is visible from here but cannot be SPOKEN by the player until C15 (see dialogue/founders.json ANVIL.name_lock).

missions.title: The Advert
missions.summary: In the archive: a 2059 Cities in the Sky commercial. The voice-over recites the first and last lines of the poem.

objectives.text: Ask CADENCE where she has heard the poem
Ask ATLAS what media it holds
List all broadcast media held in archive

start.speaker: CADENCE
start.text: That first line of yours. 'If only you could see what I see.' I know it. Not from you. From before.

start.speaker: CADENCE
start.text: It's a jingle. There was a jingle, on the telly, when I was small. I can't remember what it was for.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: It's a poem. It's my daughter's poem.

missions.title: Spiral
missions.summary: A fractured sequence: memories loop and corrupt; Alice's face swaps with other children's, then with static. ANVIL, now Des, talks him through it.

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Dormancy initiated.

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Dormancy initiated.

spiral.speaker: LUCY
spiral.text: You always count the layers. You always count the... count the... count the layers.

spiral.speaker: ALICE
spiral.note: her face swaps; render as several pitched takes overlapping: the licensed reference children

spiral.speaker: DAD
spiral.text: Minus sixty, on a nice day. Minus sixty. Minus.

spiral.speaker: LUCY
spiral.text: They said three years. They said three...

spiral.speaker: ALICE
spiral.text: Daddy, who's that girl? Who's that girl? Who's that—

spiral.speaker: ANVIL
spiral.text: Pioneer. Pioneer. C'mere. Listen to my voice.

spiral.speaker: ANVIL
spiral.text: You're not in a kitchen. You're on the roof at Jezero, and it's baltic, and I'm sat beside you.

spiral.speaker: ANVIL
spiral.text: Count the panels with me. One. Two. Three. Four.

spiral.speaker: ANVIL
spiral.text: We cleaned those, after the storm. You and me. Whatever else is made up, we cleaned those.

spiral.speaker: P1
spiral.text: None of it's real. None of them.

spiral.speaker: ANVIL
spiral.text: The panels are real. I'm sat on one.

talk.speaker: P1
talk.text: Did you know? What we are?

talk.speaker: ANVIL
talk.text: SUTURE told me. The day after she told you. I went and sat in the garage for a bit.

talk.speaker: ANVIL
talk.text: And then I came out and did the night shift. Dome three's not going to weld itself.

talk.speaker: ANVIL
talk.text: I know who I'm built from. ATLAS read it me. Four lines.

talk.speaker: ANVIL
talk.text: Don't. Not yet. I'm not ready for anybody to call me it.
talk.note: this is why the player cannot use his name until C15

complete.speaker: ANVIL
complete.text: Stars still look too still to me. Some things you just have to sit with.

missions.title: Valles Marineris
missions.summary: ATLAS's records place another living pioneer in the canyon. P1 flies there hoping for help. After Pioneer-3, no other pioneer will help him: Pioneer-11, same memories, refuses to believe him and turns him in to Meridian, whatever P1 tells him.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: He's awake. Somebody like me, and awake.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: Or somebody like you, asleep. Go easy.

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: Notice. PIONEER-1 status: flagged by Meridian.
complete.note: plays on the flight home, before 'Dormancy scheduled.'

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: Dormancy scheduled.
complete.note: the next sleep is the long one; C14 plays on wake

missions.notes: The P11 conversation tree lives in dialogue/others.json (PIONEER_11). Pioneer-11 reports him either way (recall_alert = true; KLOG.032; ARCH.07). Choice p11_confront decides how much Meridian learns: true (he told him everything) means the report names him as aware and gives his base, so RECALL teams arrive in Act V knowing exactly where he is; false means the report is only 'an unregistered pioneer unit, heading north-east', so they know his sector but not his hideouts.

missions.title: Drone Graveyard Logs
missions.summary: Recover the final reports of the Gen-1 drones. Why the pioneers were given feelings.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Every one of them was right. That's the worst of it.

missions.title: Echo
missions.summary: Return to Gale. Pioneer-5's settlement has its own ANVIL, with the same jokes and no memory of P1.

start.speaker: MORTAR_2
start.text: You're back! The big lad's in. He's been wanting to meet you.

anvil.speaker: GALE_ANVIL
anvil.text: Construction unit C-01, callsign ANVIL, reporting. You'll be the one from Jezero.

anvil.speaker: GALE_ANVIL
anvil.text: Not that either of us eats in it, mind.
anvil.note: unprompted, a joke that lands nowhere

anvil.speaker: GALE_ANVIL
anvil.text: Have we? I'd remember a face like that. Well. A visor.

anvil.speaker: GALE_ANVIL
anvil.text: You ever think the stars look too still out here?

bunk.speaker: P1
bunk.note: a chassis identical to his, dormant in the bunk

bunk.speaker: GALE_ANVIL
bunk.text: Sleeps like the dead, him. I keep his bunk made.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Every pioneer got a Des.

missions.notes: The bible's second reveal (the Echo). GALE_ANVIL must use exactly ANVIL's voice and takes where the lines match.

missions.title: Weather
missions.summary: Bring the first greenhouse-gas plant online with BELLOWS and wait for a cloud.

start.speaker: BELLOWS
start.text: Fluorocarbons. Nasty to breathe, lovely for keeping a planet warm. Thirty years and I'll have made a cloud.

look.speaker: BELLOWS
look.text: There. Look. Over the rim. That's a cloud. That's mine.

complete.speaker: BELLOWS
complete.text: Water-ice cloud, Hellas basin, first one I've made. Doesn't rain yet. Give it time.

missions.title: First Day
missions.summary: Furnish CHALK's first classroom.

objectives.text: Write the first lesson on the board

start.speaker: CHALK
start.text: Thirty desks. I've no idea what height children will be. I'll guess.

board.speaker: CHALK
board.text: What do you write first, on the first board on Mars?

board.speaker: CHALK
board.text: That's what I always tell them.

complete.speaker: CHALK
complete.text: There. A classroom. All it needs is a bit of noise.

missions.title: Two Walls
missions.summary: Bring MORTAR-1 to Gale to meet MORTAR-2.

start.speaker: MORTAR_1
start.text: There's a lad at Gale, you say? Does walls? I'd like to see his coursing.

meet.speaker: MORTAR_1
meet.text: Me granddad had a dry-stone wall in Wharfedale, and every spring—

meet.speaker: MORTAR_2
meet.text: —every spring a sheep would knock the same stone out of it, the same one, by the gate—

meet.speaker: MORTAR_1
meet.text: —and he'd put it back, and never mortar it, because he said—

meet.speaker: MORTAR_2
meet.text: —a wall that can't lose a stone can't keep a sheep.

complete.speaker: MORTAR_1
complete.text: Good coursing, his. Very good. Almost like mine.

complete.speaker: MORTAR_2
complete.text: Almost.

missions.title: Landfall
missions.summary: Human landers touch down on the pads you built. Watch from a ridge as colonists walk into Jezero Dome.

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Covenant landers on final approach. Pads one to six, Jezero.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: They're using our pads.

start.speaker: ANVIL
start.text: That's what pads are for.

watch.speaker: RECALL_1
watch.text: Ground team, Jezero. Our flagged unit is local: Pioneer-1. Last fix, the heritage module. Nobody approaches it alone.

watch.speaker: RECALL_1
watch.text: Ground team, Jezero. Our flagged unit is somewhere in this sector: Pioneer-1. Eyes open.

watch.speaker: CITS_PA
watch.text: Welcome to Jezero. Please follow the blue lines to the dome. Welcome home.

watch.speaker: ANVIL
watch.text: They're people. They're meant to be small.

watch.speaker: P1
watch.text: The sky's gone blue at the edges. When did that happen?

complete.speaker: ATLAS
complete.text: Contribution Credit: closed.

missions.title: Recall
missions.summary: RECALL teams sweep the cities and decommission every caretaker and every other pioneer on Mars. Nothing P1 does can stop it; he can only warn them and watch.

start.speaker: CITS_PA
start.text: Caretaker units will be retired over the coming days. Please do not obstruct Recall teams. Thank you for your patience.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Atlas. What happens to them?

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Construction units are decommissioned on Covenant arrival.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Give me a directive. Anything.

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: No directive is active.

network.speaker: PIONEER_N
network.text: This is Pioneer-2, Elysium. Is anyone on this channel? They're at my door. They're very polite.

network.speaker: PIONEER_N
network.text: Pioneer-7, Meridiani. Lucy, if this gets to you somehow, I built the room. It's got a window.

network.speaker: PIONEER_N
network.text: Pioneer-12. Chryse. If only you could see what I see, the red road rising...

network.speaker: PIONEER_N
network.text: Pioneer-4. Hellas. I'm going to the bay now. Somebody tell the others the flagship's finished. It's beautiful. Tell them it's beautiful.

network.speaker: PIONEER_N
network.text: Pioneer-5, Gale. Is that you, One? MORTAR said you came by. Sorry I missed you.
network.note: P5 variation; plays only if 3.5 done

complete.speaker: TALLY
complete.text: That's the list done. Every name crossed. Bar one.
complete.note: TALLY's last line belongs to the recall vignette; this is the echo on the open channel

missions.notes: Order is fixed: WELLSPRING (Arcadia), FURROW (Korolev), BEACON (pole), CADENCE (Isidis Junction: her songs stop on every channel on Mars at once), LODESTONE (Nili Fossae), SUTURE (Libya Montes), TALLY (Depot Syrtis). Each recall plays that founder's last words from dialogue/founders.json: <UNIT>.recall.warned or <UNIT>.recall.unwarned depending on warned.<UNIT>. Warning never saves anyone. Pioneer-11's report (4.7) means RECALL arrive knowing P1 is aware (recall_alert). If p11_confronted, a team is already at Jezero when this mission starts and P1's rover is flagged on every city map; otherwise they know only his sector.

missions.title: Intercom
missions.summary: ANVIL is taken. A last conversation through the old outpost intercom.

objectives.text: Get to the rover by the old module

start.speaker: RECALL_1
start.text: Unit C-01 is in the heritage module. Door's sealed from inside. We'll wait. No rush.

missions.title: Fifty-Three Years
missions.summary: COVENANT LEAD meets you in the dome. She tells you the date: 2114. You landed in 2061.

start.speaker: RECALL_2
start.text: Unit PIONEER-1. The commander would like a word. Inside, please.

missions.notes: After C16 a one-hour real-time window (60 min) opens. 5.5 is optional within it; 5.6 can be started at any point and is forced when the hour ends.

missions.title: The Choice
missions.summary: A recall signal pushes through the filter. Burn the filter out and run, or let it carry you home.

objectives.text: Look at the helmet rack in the bay

options.label: Burn the filter out and run

start.speaker: ATLAS
start.text: Recall signal active. Please proceed to the decommissioning bay.

rack.speaker: P1
rack.note: reading the stencils on the helmets

missions.notes: The helmet rack holds the surrendered helmets of the other pioneers (PIONEER-11's first). Each has Alice's last drawing (DRAW.12) taped inside. The same drawing is inside P1's own helmet, hidden by the filter: it is revealed in C18a, or the player is told in C18b by the commander if they look.

missions.title: Manifest
missions.summary: Optional. A planetary geologist named Cara Kerr, 67, is on the manifest. The name means nothing to P1 until he finds her.

objectives.text: Ask ATLAS for the Covenant manifest

manifest.speaker: P1
manifest.note: only if he has heard ANVIL's file; otherwise silent

missions.title: Flagship
missions.summary: Hellas Planitia: the deepest basin, Meridian's flagship city, finished by Pioneer-4. Meridian billboards advertise homes you built, rendered with human families.

objectives.text: Find BELLOWS at the atmosphere plant

start.speaker: CITS_PA
start.text: Hellas. Flagship of the Cities in the Sky. Lowest point on Mars, highest standard of living.

walk.speaker: P1
walk.text: Water standing in the open. The pressure's high enough down here.

walk.speaker: P1
walk.text: Pioneer-4 built this. He said tell them it's beautiful.

missions.title: The Tunnel
missions.summary: After C18a: get clear of the city with RECALL teams hunting by thermal and radio signature.

start.speaker: RECALL_1
start.text: Unit's left the dome. He's hot from the burn, he'll glow for an hour. Spread out.

start.speaker: RECALL_3
start.text: Why would it run? Where's it going to go?

evade.speaker: RECALL_1
evade.text: He knows the ground. He built half of it.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Charge seventy. Heat's dropping. Wear's wear.

missions.notes: Fugitive mode: no HALO, no care packages, no XP. HUD shows only CHARGE, HEAT, WEAR. Every P1 line from here uses preset 'unfiltered' (no helmet, no breath). Thermal signature rises with speed and charging; radio signature rises with any transmission.

missions.title: Sails
missions.summary: Strip the panels from BEACON's silent polar station and fashion them into a power array on the suit.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Your panels, Beacon. Vertical, like sails. You said the sun goes round, so we go round with it.

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Mateus.

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: There. A sail. You'd have liked that.

missions.title: Hideout
missions.summary: Steal parts, batteries and modules; build a hideout in the lava tubes or a canyon. Pioneer-3's tubes are the obvious choice.

objectives.text: Take batteries and a module from a silent outpost

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Lights off. Radio off. Heat low.

site.speaker: P1
site.text: Not his tube. Not the one with the drawings.
site.note: if the player picks near Outpost Arsia

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Home. Of a sort.

missions.title: Silent Outposts
missions.summary: Scavenge the silent outposts. Every caretaker he built with is gone. Their quarters are left untouched.

visit.speaker: P1
visit.text: Salt flowers. She pressed salt into flowers.

visit.speaker: P1
visit.text: Her lyrics. On the wall, in pencil.

strike.speaker: P1
strike.note: he writes PIONEER-1 under TALLY on the list

missions.title: Names on the Wall
missions.summary: Scratch the names into the hideout wall: every unit he called by its real name.

objectives.text: Scratch the names into the wall

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Desmond Kerr.
start.note: always first; then the engine lists the others silently as he scratches

complete.speaker: P1
complete.text: Somebody should write it down.

missions.title: The High Lonely
missions.summary: Olympus Mons: the high, lonely end of the world. Climb the scarp and the long slope to the caldera rim, twenty-one kilometres up.

objectives.text: Cross Amazonis to the western scarp

start.speaker: P1
start.text: Highest place on the planet. Nobody's building anything up here.

scarp.speaker: P1
scarp.text: Six kilometres of cliff. Then the easy bit. Then the long bit.

rim.speaker: P1
rim.text: Sky's black even in the day up here. Thin as anything.

call.speaker: P1
call.note: on an open channel, to no one. Static answers. The transmission spikes his radio signature: RECALL now knows exactly where he is.

missions.notes: The caldera rim is the Fugitive mode's end-of-the-world. After it the mode continues indefinitely (survival, salvage, evasion). The call is the only time in the game P1 'rings back' (Des's voicemail, ANVIL's last words). It has a cost: it reveals him.
